subject: Proposal: FastKart Hosted API commit uplift & tier realignment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@fastkart.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: FastKart Hosted API commit uplift & tier realignment

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, I’m sending a proposed path to increase FastKart’s monthly hosted API commit to support your holiday traffic surge while keeping per-token economics favorable. Summary: 

- Current: 2.5M tokens/mo commit, standard rate band A (0–2.5M)
- Proposal: step to 5M tokens/mo commit (effective Oct 1), with a 3-month ramp window and a 250k-token burst pocket for each month during the ramp.
- Pricing: new tier rates attached in the sheet (we can offer tiered pricing for usage above commit).
- Onboarding credit: we’ve included a one-time operations credit to offset initial delta (SOW contains two options).

Operational notes: we’ll reserve dedicated serving capacity on our Redwood Dedicated pool during the ramp weeks to meet your latency SLOs. Monica (cc’d) will coordinate scheduling.

Attachments: FK_SOW_v2.pdf, fastkart_traffic_calc_Aug2026.xlsx

Can we lock a procurement timeline? If you’re available I can schedule a 30-min wrap-up with procurement this week.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132


From: Elena Ruiz <elena@fastkart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fastkart.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: FastKart Hosted API commit uplift & tier realignment

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the SOW. A few items from procurement and product: 

1) Pricing: our finance team is asking if you can provide a short-term onboarding concession — 30% credit against overage for the first two billing cycles while the ramp is in effect.
2) Start date: we prefer a hard start aligned to Oct 1 and will need a firm activation checklist.
3) Rate tiers: would you consider an additional mid-band (5–7.5M) at a slightly reduced per-token rate to avoid large billing jumps if we hit peak?
4) Security: please confirm SOC2 scoping for the Dedicated pool and provide the latest evidence (audit window).

I’m attaching FastKart’s PO template — procurement will push that through once we have pricing and security confirmation.

Thanks —
Elena Ruiz
VP Product, FastKart
elena@fastkart.com
Attachment: FastKart_PO_Template.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: FastKart Hosted API commit uplift & tier realignment

Forwarding Elena’s reply — procurement is asking for a 30% onboarding credit for first two cycles and an extra mid-band rate.

Internal notes / recommended play: 
- Offer a 20% onboarding credit instead of 30% (we can do 30% but only if they commit to 9 months minimum); that reduces short-term revenue hit and keeps momentum.
- Add a temporary mid-band (5–7.5M) with a small step-down in per-token price; label it "ramp-mid" and make it expire after 6 months.
- Monica: confirm ops lead time for reserving Dedicated capacity and whether we can guarantee SOC2 artifacts by Aug 11. If SOC2 evidence needs PM/R&D support, loop in security.
- Legal: we should send over a revised SOW and a clean signature packet to avoid back-and-forth redlines. I’ll coordinate DocuSign.

Can you draft a reply with the revised numbers and the DocuSign link? I’ll be on standby.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: FastKart Hosted API commit uplift & tier realignment

Thanks Rishi —

Ops checklist and timing: 
- Capacity: we can reserve an incremental Dedicated pool slice to support up to 6M sustained tokens with a 10-day lead time for provisioning; for Oct 1 activation we need sign-off no later than Aug 18.
- Ramp plan: recommend a 4-week staged ramp (week 1: 1.5x baseline, week 2: 2.0x, week 3: 2.5x, week 4: full commit). That reduces cold-cache effects.
- SOC2 evidence: security can provide the latest Type II report; I’ll request the specific control excerpts and expected delivery by Aug 11 (we’ve done this for other Dedicated customers).
- Legal redlines: minimal expected — we should send an SOW that lists the ramp schedule and burst pocket explicitly. I’ll update the SOW to include activation checklist and ops contact.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5001/FK-2026-089), Draft DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-FK-SOW).

Attachments to send with customer: FK_SOW_v2.pdf (will update), fastkart_traffic_calc_Aug2026.xlsx

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0177

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@fastkart.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@fastkart.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: FastKart Hosted API commit uplift & tier realignment

Hi Elena & team —

Thanks for the clear list. After internal review here’s what we can commit to: 

1) Onboarding credit: 20% credit against overage for the first two billing cycles. We can increase to 30% if FastKart signs a 9-month minimum term.
2) Mid-band: we’ll add a temporary mid-band (5–7.5M) for the first 6 months at a reduced per-token rate; label: "ramp-mid".
3) Start date & ops: Oct 1 start is OK — Monica will reserve capacity, and we need signed SOW + PO by Aug 18 to guarantee activation.
4) Security: SOC2 Type II excerpts will be provided by Aug 11.

Next steps: I’ve attached an updated SOW (FK_SOW_v2.pdf) with the ramp schedule and the revised pricing sheet. Please confirm you accept the 20% onboarding credit and whether you’ll sign the 9-month minimum to secure the 30% credit option. If everything looks good, I’ll send the DocuSign packet and coordinate procurement.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-FK-SOW
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5001/FK-2026-089

Thanks —
